MRT.note: The document describes youth employability training, not training for civil servants.

facts.fact: Mauritania's vocational training minister launched the France-funded, Simplon-implemented project to support youth employability in digital, training 2,150 beneficiaries in six cities.
facts.system: Soutien a la employabilite des jeunes en Mauritanie dans le numerique

facts.fact: Simplon Mauritania's country director says over three years of partnership with the French embassy strengthened basic digital skills for nearly 5,000 beneficiaries.
